title: Knight's Snack
setup: Your knight on f3 eyes eight squares — and a black bishop is sitting on one of them.
hint: The knight's eight squares are easy to overlook. Which of them has a black piece standing on it?
explanation:
## The Idea

From f3 the knight's L reaches e5: two squares forward, one across. The black bishop standing there has **no defender**.

{{Nxe5}} wins the bishop for free. No straight line joins f3 and e5, which is exactly why a capture like this is easy to miss.

Before every move, glance at all eight squares your knight reaches. Loose pieces like to hide on them.
